editPurpose: Match existing in-game character identity, anatomy, poses and camera angle; change clothes only.

entries.prompt: Edit the reference SPRITE SHEET by changing ONLY THE OUTFIT to a tiny Santa costume. This is a clothing texture edit on the SAME existing game character, NOT a new character design. CRITICAL: Copy the exact face, huge head, short tiny torso, extremely stubby legs, body silhouette, perspective, pose of every one of the40 figures from the reference. Head/hair occupies about TWO THIRDS of the standing figure height; keep that ratio. Keep exact face size, eye locations, hair curl shape, foot positions and each figure's camera view. Do NOT normalize directions: row1 is the reference's slightly-turned front view, row2 its back view, row3 its front-right three-quarter view (NOT pure profile), row4 its diagonal view, row5 its back-side diagonal with a little face visible (NOT full back). Preserve reference exactly, including how much of head top is visible: overhead orthographic camera looking down, not eye-level. Replace green jacket with red Santa coat white fur trim, add black belt gold buckle; replace shorts with red shorts, keep the SAME tiny boots and short limbs. Add a red Santa cap with white fur brim and pompom ON TOP of existing full-sized hair/head; hat may extend upward into empty margin, NEVER SHRINK THE HEAD OR LENGTHEN BODY to make room. No beard, glasses, bag or extra props. Preserve original soft matte 3D painted game rendering, lighting, size and anatomy; avoid glossy new toy character. Layout exactly8columns x5rows,40 figures, transparent background, no text, no layout change, no borders, all figures complete.

Edit the existing game SPRITE SHEET, changing ONLY THE CLOTHES. This is NOT a new character design. Every one of40 figures must keep EXACT original face, eye locations, huge head, original hair, VERY SHORT body and stubby limbs, existing expression, skeleton, hand/foot positions, and camera view OF THAT INDIVIDUAL CELL. Reference head/hair is about TWO THIRDS of standing figure; preserve this ratio. Preserve the exact overhead orthographic camera pitch and every cell's turn angle. Do not reinterpret row directions, do not replace angled fronts by straight front or profiles, do not copy one row across others. Even within a row a character can turn: faithfully retain EACH CELL'S view and pose. KEEP original original soft matte3D painted rendering, lighting and material style. Hats go OVER existing full-size head/hair and may extend into margin: NEVER shrink a head, lengthen body, move an eye or switch camera to accommodate a hat. No eye-level camera, no adult proportions or glossy redesign. Exactly8columns x5rows,40 separate intact figures in same layout and same relative sizes as reference. No words, labels, frame lines, floor, chair, rod, equipment or backdrop. True transparent alpha background. Change outfit to: yellow duck kindergarten bucket hat with two little eyes and orange duck bill above brim, sky-blue short kindergarten smock, tiny yellow bow, very short navy shorts, tiny yellow shoes retaining exact original boot dimensions, tiny duck backpack only where back is shown. Do NOT add long legs or socks, preserve existing extremely short limbs.
